name: Manuscript
description: Your novel and stories, read by your bot section by section into a story bible, on nine tabs beside your own notes: characters, plot and subplots, timeline, structure, world, science, themes, voice, and an editor's desk of what needs your eye. Each tab opens with a short brief of what it adds up to. Correct any fact and it stays corrected. Ask it to show you something and it makes a view on the right tab, drawn in Maps too when it is a drawing, or points at the passage in your text. It never changes your manuscript.
author: Cypher Sisters

tools.manuscript_list: The writer's manuscripts on this computer, each with its sections, word counts and how far her bot has read it.
tools.manuscript_read: The text of one section of one of the writer's manuscripts, by its number or heading.
tools.manuscript_status: How far her bot has read one manuscript into its story bible, in one line.
tools.manuscript_analyze: Start your bot reading one manuscript again to rebuild its story bible. It starts only after you said yes; asked without your yes it only tells your bot what to ask you.
tools.manuscript_ask: An answer to a question about one manuscript, from its story bible and the sections that match the question best, citing sections by number.
tools.manuscript_show: Makes a view on one tab of the Manuscript page, such as a character's arc, a timeline or a family tree, from the story bible, and keeps it on that tab.
tools.manuscript_point: Points the Manuscript page at a passage: it opens the section, scrolls to the words and highlights them.
tools.manuscript_correct: Corrects one fact in a manuscript's story bible, in the writer's words, such as who is whose cousin, another name a character goes by, a character's role or importance, or what kind of place a place is. It stays corrected when the book is read again.
tools.manuscript_desk: The editor's desk for one manuscript: plot holes, timeline mismatches, science that fails, character holes, continuity slips and open questions, most serious first. Lists the open items, or keeps, dismisses or adds a note to one.
tools.manuscript_notes_read: The writer's notes for one manuscript on characters, plot and subplots, timeline, structure, world building, science, themes, voice or the editor's desk.
tools.manuscript_notes_append: Adds a dated section to the end of the writer's notes for one manuscript on one subject. Her manuscript stays as it is.
tools.manuscript_remove: Put one manuscript away into a Removed folder inside Manuscripts, with its original file, bible, views, notes and pictures. Nothing is deleted.

consent: Manuscript keeps your manuscripts and your notes in a Manuscripts folder in My files. Your bot reads each manuscript with the model on this computer and keeps its notes and views in that folder too, and it never changes your manuscript text. It doesn't use the internet once it is installed, and removing it never removes your files.
